Frequently asked questions.

Am I the right fit for this?

+

We don’t take everyone, and there are only 5 spots. This is for detailing and protection businesses doing at least $10K a month. Mobile, shop, or both. You need room for more jobs and $50 a day for ads. If that’s you, fill out the application. If it’s not, don’t waste your time or ours.

What do I get in the 4 weeks?

+

An offer that makes people want to book. Ad scripts written for you, and you film one day, on your phone. Your Facebook and Instagram ads built and run every day. The LEADFUSE App texting every lead back for you. A weekly check on your numbers, and a week-4 review where we look at what you spent, your leads and your booked jobs together.

How does the money work?

+

You put down a deposit on your first call. For most owners, it’s about the price of one coating job. Keep going after 4 weeks? Your deposit comes off your program, so those 4 weeks cost you nothing. Walk away? The deposit covers your 4 weeks. Nothing else to pay. Your ad spend goes to Meta, not us.

Why is there a deposit?

+

Because we’ve tried “$0 to start.” The people who signed up weren’t serious. They didn’t film. They didn’t call their leads back. Then they blamed the ads. We take this seriously because our business depends on it. Yours probably does too.

What if I change my mind?

+

The 72-hour guarantee. Don’t like our onboarding? Don’t like how we communicate? Having second thoughts? Tell us within 72 hours of paying your deposit and we’ll refund it.

What if it doesn’t work?

+

The performance guarantee. Before you pay a dollar, we agree on a number, in writing. If we don’t hit it in your first 4 weeks, you get your deposit back. No questions asked. As long as you do your part: film within 7 days, keep your ads on, call your leads back fast, and log your jobs in the App. We go over all of it on the call.

How fast do my ads go live?

+

Within 7 days of your launch call. The faster you film, the faster you’re live.

When does this end?

+

Saturday, October 31 at midnight Pacific, or when the 5 spots are gone. Whichever comes first.
